result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.topological_overlap()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Compute the topological overlap matrix (TOM). ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L16289-L16355){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.topological_overlap(return_dict=False) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} ![Topological overlap matrix](/assets/graphs/topological-overlap.light.svg){.lightbox fig-alt="A five-gene network: a diamond G1 to G4 with G5 hanging off G4. G1 and G4 are not linked but share the two neighbors G2 and G3, drawn in the accent color, so their topological overlap is 2 over min(2, 3) + 1, that is 0.67. The table is the full symmetric matrix with 1 on the diagonal and the G1, G4 entries highlighted." width="100%"} For each pair of nodes `(i, j)`, the topological overlap measures how much they share the same neighbors, normalized by the less-connected node's degree: `TOM(i, j) = (|N(i) ∩ N(j)| + a_ij) / (min(k_i, k_j) + 1 - a_ij)` where `a_ij` is 1 if `(i, j)` is an edge, `k` is degree, and `N` is the neighbor set. Diagonal entries are 1.0. This is the standard TOM from WGCNA (weighted gene co-expression network analysis), widely used in genomics for clustering genes into co-expression modules. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [return_dict]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If `True`, return the TOM as a nested dictionary. Otherwise return `self` for chaining. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [dict or Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A `{node_id: {node_id: tom_value}}` nested dictionary, or `self`. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#eb2b6e9d .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec g = ( ec.Graph() .add_nodes(["A", "B", "C", "D"]) .add_edges([("A", "B"), ("A", "C"), ("B", "C"), ("C", "D")]) ) tom = g.topological_overlap(return_dict=True) a_id = g.get_id_from_label("A") b_id = g.get_id_from_label("B") tom[a_id][b_id] ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 1.0 ``` ::: :::
